title: Wrapping sequence numbers
hints: Keep one bit per number, at index `sequence % 256`. Inside the window every number has its own index, so a bit can only ever mean one number at a time.

When the latest moves forward by `d`, clear the bits of the numbers you skipped over (or all of them if `d` is 256 or more) before setting the new one: those slots still hold marks from numbers 256 earlier.
